dish: Kushiro ramen — thin noodles in clear bonito-shōyu broth
n: Kushiro Rāmen Kawamura (釧路ラーメン 河むら)
w: The mainstream of Kushiro ramen: a crystal-clear, bonito-led shōyu soup and fine curly noodles, served into the Suehiro nightlife hours.

dish: Kushiro robatayaki — the quayside 'Ganpeki Robata' charcoal grill (mid-May–Oct)
n: Kushiro Fisherman's Wharf MOO & Ganpeki Robata (釧路フィッシャーマンズワーフMOO・岸壁炉ばた)
address: At the foot of Nusamai Bridge, Kushiro, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Kushiro's harbour hall by Nusamai Bridge — a fish market downstairs, the retro 'Minato no Yatai' upstairs, and in summer the open-air quayside robata where you grill your own catch.

dish: Akkeshi oysters — raw, grilled and in oyster dishes
n: Akkeshi Mikaku Terminal Conchiglie — Michi-no-eki Akkeshi Gourmet Park (厚岸味覚ターミナル コンキリエ)
w: The roadside station of Japan's year-round oyster town — oyster restaurants, a grill-it-yourself seafood shop and oyster sweets above Akkeshi Bay.

dish: seasonal Shiretoko salmon dishes (tokishirazu, karafuto-masu, ittō-kenzake)
n: Michi-no-eki Utoro Shiretoku restaurant (道の駅うとろ・シリエトク)
address: Utoro, Shari, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The Utoro roadside station's local-catch restaurant: spring tokishirazu, summer pink salmon, autumn-winter prime chum — Shiretoko seafood at fair prices.
